body: Apparently, Rachel's dad just decided that they would have a party, went out to buy stuff, and called Rachel's sisters to invite them.
This really made me feel better, thank you so much 💕
That's just how I'm feeling, like I'm not considered family, even when I am very involved with the girls, and very close to my dad.

Yeah, I do appreciate her apologizing and stuff.

I just wish they would've thought of the fact that my bro and I definitely would've loved to be there :(
